title: In the Time of the Butterflies
author: Julia Alvarez
current_text: In the Time of the Butterflies was withdrawn from inclusion at Paul D. Schreiber High School in Port Washington, N.Y., in 2000 because of a drawing of a homemade bomb.

sources.quote: Alvarez, Julia. In the Time of the Butterflies. Algonquin; Plume. Withdrawn from inclusion at the Paul D. Schreiber High School in Port Washington, N.Y. (2000) because of a drawing of a homemade bomb.
